title: Radio introduction at the Elks Club
summary: The interviewer introduces pianist Alton Purnell on a March 1968 radio program.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: The following is a conversation at the Elks Club on March 3rd, 1968 with Elton Purnell, the pianist.
Say something, Elton, just say anything. Hello, folks. Yeah.

On these programs, we try and bring you from time to time somebody of note in the jazz field, and today we have the great pleasure of bringing a friend of ours that I wish we'd known longer than we have. A fellow who plays a very fine piece of piano by the name of Elton Purnell. Elton, I'm glad to have you here.
Glad to be here, too, man.
